parameters.query:
INSERT INTO daily_report_delivery (report_date, claim_token, status, attempt_count, claimed_at, sent_at)
VALUES (STR_TO_DATE($1, '%Y-%m-%d'), $2, 'processing', 1, NOW(), NULL)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  attempt_count = IF(status = 'failed', attempt_count + 1, attempt_count),
  claimed_at = IF(status = 'failed', NOW(), claimed_at),
  claim_token = IF(status = 'failed', VALUES(claim_token), claim_token),
  sent_at = IF(status = 'failed', NULL, sent_at),
  status = IF(status = 'failed', 'processing', status);

nodes.name: 按统计日期认领日报
nodes.notes: 使用唯一统计日期原子认领；同一天已发送或仍在处理中时不输出认领记录，因此不会再次发信。

parameters.query:
SELECT report_date, claim_token
FROM daily_report_delivery
WHERE report_date = STR_TO_DATE($1, '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND claim_token = $2
  AND status = 'processing';
